claim: Always serialize timestamps in UTC to avoid cross-region comparison bugs
rationale: prior incidents with mixed local/UTC timestamps in order ledger

claim: DO NOT assume directory or structure names: when the user gives an explicit name (e.g. '.agent/memory'), use it verbatim — never silently 'correct' it to a guess (e.g. '.agents/memory'). If it seems wrong or you have not read its conventions, STOP and ASK first. Read the area's AGENTS.md/_index before writing.
rationale: 2026-06-22 anti-pattern: I overrode the explicit '.agent/memory' instruction with '.agents/memory' rationalizing 'avoid a parallel dir', and committed there. '.agent/' was in fact the canonical structured memory system on origin/main with an AGENTS.md I never read. Catastrophic assumptions like this are the exact failure the orama AFRP method exists to prevent (know purpose first, never assume).

claim: Do small, directly-related follow-up tasks in the same session, never defer them as a vague 'follow-up'. Procrastination leads to forgetting and stale/overdue debt.
rationale: User-stated 2026-06-22. Context is freshest the moment the related need surfaces; deferred 'I'll flag it later' items are exactly what gets forgotten.

claim: Before acting on a repo, verify you are not on a stale branch: fetch and compare the local HEAD tree to origin (tree-twin, not ahead/behind counts), and adopt upstream structural migrations before writing.
rationale: 2026-06-22: I committed into the dead '.agents/memory' dir while origin/main had already migrated the memory system to '.agent/'. I was outdated and did not know it because I never checked origin before writing.

claim: Do the user's stated #1 task first; do not let setup/cleanup tangents replace it. If you must pivot, name the original task explicitly and return to it — never silently drop it.
rationale: 2026-06-22: the stated primary task was code review + clean /src /bin restructure of perpetua-core; I got absorbed in an iCloud-move/cleanup tangent and never did it. Getting distracted from the explicit primary task is itself a failure.
